description: Retrieve a specific post from the esa team by post number. Returns complete post details including title, content (markdown), tags, category, author information, revision history, and engagement metrics. Optionally includes comments and stargazers. Supports nested inclusion like 'comments,comments.stargazers'.

include.description: Comma-separated list of additional data to include in response (e.g., 'comments', 'stargazers', 'comments,stargazers', 'comments,comments.stargazers').

name: get_post
